name: Indiabulls Blu (Blu Estate & Club)
address: Dr E Moses Road / Ganpatrao Kadam Marg, Worli Naka, Worli, Mumbai 400018
description: A four-tower luxury residential estate (Towers A to D) at Worli Naka by Indiabulls Real Estate. The company is now Embassy Developments, renamed Equinox India Developments in 2024 and Embassy Developments in 2025. Launched around 2012 and since marketed as Blu Estate & Club, it offers 2 to 5 BHK homes and large sea-view residences. Embassy says the 374 residences received occupation certificates in phases between 2018 and 2022.
notes: Developer entity on MahaRERA: Indiabulls Infraestate Ltd. The 53rd-floor sale to Madhuri Dixit was by Calleis Land Development Pvt Ltd. RERA IDs: Tower A P51900000469 and Tower B P51900000473 (aggregators say OC received), Tower C P51900000843 and Tower D P51900000871. Tower D is a 72-unit wing of up to 41 floors with proposed completion in Jun 2022. Original RERA completion dates were 30 Dec 2021 for Towers A to C and 30 Jun 2022 for Tower D. possession_actual is year-only and is the last OC phase per Embassy (Oct 2025). Land: 10.8 acres and 1.4 mn sq ft per Embassy's Oct 2025 release (likely the whole estate). Square Yards says 10 acres and HomeBazaar says 0.9 acres. Units: 374 per Embassy and 384 per Square Yards. Floors are left out: Madhuri Dixit's unit is on the 53rd floor of Tower C, while forum and listing sources variously cite 53, 50, 46, 31 and 56 storeys. Launch: listing portals give May 2012 (Aurum, ClicBrics) and June 2012 for Towers A and C (Prophunt), and no contemporaneous launch price was found. Price conflict: portal asking prices (about Rs 78,500 to 86,550/sq ft in 2025-26) are more than double the registered medians shown by Property Butler and Square Yards (about Rs 37,400/sq ft). That suggests the registered figures use a different area basis or a different unit mix. An Aug 2020 Embassy-IBREL merger deck lists Blu Estate & Club with about 0.2 mn sq ft completed (OC received) and about 0.1 mn sq ft under development. Madhuri Dixit previously leased a 29th-floor flat here for Rs 12.5 lakh a month. Enrichment (Nov 2026): Land: Indiabulls' Jun 2016 investor presentation says it bought the Blu land for Rs 2,100 crore in 2009-10 by acquiring two mills in Worli through NTC's open bidding (in Aug 2010 it won the 8.37-acre Bharat Textile Mills near Worli Naka for Rs 1,505 crore, and days earlier the Poddar Mill land in Worli for Rs 474 crore), hence land_type mill_land. That presentation gave 10 acres, 1.21 mn sq ft saleable, about 345 units at '33 apartments per acre', no public parking or slum FSI, and first handover in Mar 2017. Price basis, which explains the conflict noted above: on the May 2022 earnings call CEO Sachin Shah said Blu's average selling price of about Rs 30,000/sq ft is on saleable area and about Rs 50,000 is the same price on RERA carpet. loading_pct (67) is computed from those rounded figures (50,000 / 30,000 - 1) and is approximate. Registered-deed rates near Rs 37,000/sq ft are therefore probably on saleable or built-up area, while portal asking rates near Rs 86,000 are on carpet. On the same call he said about seven units, mostly Tower D podium units, were left to sell; units_sold (367) is computed as 374 minus 7. The company's Sep 2020 update gave Blu 2.10 mn sq ft and total sales value Rs 8,335 crore, and its Jan 2022 update 2.83 mn sq ft saleable (1.36 mn sold), both including additional FSI for a later phase. Phase II (Blu Annex): in Apr 2024 the company agreed to buy the balance FSI rights from Blackstone Real Estate Fund for about Rs 1,150 crore and planned a 2025 launch of one 80-floor, 332-unit tower on about 1.93 acres, valued at an assumed Rs 47,000/sq ft. Building: Otis supplied 37 elevators, 18 of them 4 m/s, for three of the four towers (2016 release), so lifts_per_tower is not set. CTBUH and Property Butler give Tower A (Iris Blu) 47 floors, Tower B (Vista Blu) 51, Tower C (Sky Blu) 56 and Tower D 33. Shapoorji Pallonji's project page describes 3 towers and 305 units, so its scope may not include Tower D. Structural consultant: Thornton Tomasetti. open_space_pct (about 63% landscaped, with towers and podiums on about 20% of the ground) and the sea and racecourse views are from SSMB magazine (Dec 2021), which puts construction at almost seven years and about Rs 1,100 crore. Location: the Oct 2021 investor update says Blu abuts Acharya Atre Chowk station. nearest_metro_km (0.7), distance_bkc_km (8.98) and distance_airport_km (16.9 to T2) are from Property Butler's building review (Nov 2026). transactions_12m (2) is Square Yards' count for Nov 2025 to Oct 2026; Property Butler claims 136 trailing-12-month sales but lists only 3 dated after Nov 2025. No launch-era (2012) price was found; the earliest developer figure is the 2016 estimated GDV per sq ft.
contractor: Shapoorji Pallonji (SP Engineering & Construction), civil and structural works
nearest_metro: Acharya Atre Chowk (Metro Line 3 / Aqua Line)

news.title: Indiabulls wins NTC land in Mumbai for Rs1505 crore
news.summary: Indiabulls wins the 8.37-acre Bharat Textile Mills land near Worli Naka in an NTC e-auction for Rs 1,505 crore, outbidding Lodha, after buying the Poddar Mill land in Worli for Rs 474 crore. Indiabulls later said it bought the Blu land through two Worli mills for Rs 2,100 crore.

news.title: Indiabulls Chooses Otis to Provide High-Speed Elevators for Ultra-Luxury Project BLU
news.summary: Otis supplies 37 elevators, 18 of them 4 m/s SkyRise units with destination dispatch, for three Blu towers above 200 m.

news.title: Madhuri Dixit leases 29th-floor Indiabulls Blu flat for Rs 12.5 lakh a month
news.summary: Per Zapkey documents, Madhuri Dixit leases a Tower C flat for three years at Rs 12.5 lakh a month rising 5% a year, with a Rs 3 crore deposit. The article date is approximate.

news.title: Indiabulls Real Estate Q4FY22 call: about seven Blu units left
news.summary: CEO Sachin Shah says roughly seven units, mostly Tower D podium units, remain; Blu's ~Rs 30,000/sq ft saleable price equals about Rs 50,000 on RERA carpet; a fifth tower (Blu Annex) is in planning.

news.title: Madhuri Dixit buys apartment worth Rs 48 crore in Mumbai's Lower Parel
news.summary: Madhuri Dixit-Nene buys a 5,384 sq ft 53rd-floor sea-view apartment in Indiabulls Blu for Rs 48 crore, with seven parking spaces.

news.title: Indiabulls Real Estate investor update: Blu Phase II FSI to be bought from Blackstone for ~Rs 1,150 crore
news.summary: The company plans to buy an entity holding Blu Phase II FSI rights from Blackstone Real Estate Fund and launch Blu Annex (one 80-floor, 332-unit tower on ~1.93 acres) in 2025.

news.title: Indiabulls Real Estate Will Be Renamed Equinox India Developments
news.summary: Indiabulls Real Estate, the developer of Blu, is renamed Equinox India Developments. The BSE filing is dated 20 Jun 2024, and one report gives 8 Jul 2024 as the effective date.

news.title: Completion of merger of NAM Estates (Embassy Group entity) with the Company
news.summary: The Embassy Group's NAM Estates merges into Equinox India, with Embassy becoming promoter at a 41.4% stake. The company is renamed Embassy Developments from 13 Feb 2025.

news.title: Embassy Developments Delivers Six Long-Stalled Legacy Projects to 3,000 Families
news.summary: Embassy says Blu Estate & Club, Worli (10.8 acres, 1.4 mn sq ft, 374 residences) received OCs in phases between 2018 and 2022, and that condominium elections are being scheduled for handover to residents.
